content:
You are visiting San Francisco for the day and want to meet as many friends as possible. Solve the problem by considering various different schedules and picking the best one to optimize your goals.

Travel distances (in minutes):
Financial District to Russian Hill: 10.
Financial District to Sunset District: 31.
Financial District to North Beach: 7.
Financial District to The Castro: 23.
Financial District to Golden Gate Park: 23.
Russian Hill to Financial District: 11.
Russian Hill to Sunset District: 23.
Russian Hill to North Beach: 5.
Russian Hill to The Castro: 21.
Russian Hill to Golden Gate Park: 21.
Sunset District to Financial District: 30.
Sunset District to Russian Hill: 24.
Sunset District to North Beach: 29.
Sunset District to The Castro: 17.
Sunset District to Golden Gate Park: 11.
North Beach to Financial District: 8.
North Beach to Russian Hill: 4.
North Beach to Sunset District: 27.
North Beach to The Castro: 22.
North Beach to Golden Gate Park: 22.
The Castro to Financial District: 20.
The Castro to Russian Hill: 18.
The Castro to Sunset District: 17.
The Castro to North Beach: 20.
The Castro to Golden Gate Park: 11.
Golden Gate Park to Financial District: 26.
Golden Gate Park to Russian Hill: 19.
Golden Gate Park to Sunset District: 10.
Golden Gate Park to North Beach: 24.
Golden Gate Park to The Castro: 13.

CONSTRAINTS: You arrive at Financial District at 9:00AM. Ronald will be at Russian Hill from 1:45PM to 5:15PM. You'd like to meet Ronald for a minimum of 105 minutes. Patricia will be at Sunset District from 9:15AM to 10:00PM. You'd like to meet Patricia for a minimum of 60 minutes. Laura will be at North Beach from 12:30PM to 12:45PM. You'd like to meet Laura for a minimum of 15 minutes. Emily will be at The Castro from 4:15PM to 6:30PM. You'd like to meet Emily for a minimum of 60 minutes. Mary will be at Golden Gate Park from 3:00PM to 4:30PM. You'd like to meet Mary for a minimum of 60 minutes.

Your response should start with 'SOLUTION:'.

Please output the meeting schedule in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

SOLUTION:
{
  "itinerary": [
    {
      "action": "meet",
      "person": "Patricia",
      "start_time": "09:31",
      "end_time": "10:31"
    },
    {
      "action": "meet",
      "person": "Laura",
      "start_time": "12:30",
      "end_time": "12:45"
    },
    {
      "action": "meet",
      "person": "Ronald",
      "start_time": "13:45",
      "end_time": "15:30"
    },
    {
      "action": "meet",
      "person": "Emily",
      "start_time": "16:15",
      "end_time": "17:15"
    }
  ]
}

Explanation:
Because of the tight time windows and the travel durations between locations, it is impossible to schedule meetings with all five friends. In particular, Ronald (available at Russian Hill from 13:45 to 17:15 and needing 105 minutes) and Mary (at Golden Gate Park from 15:00 to 16:30 for 60 minutes) cannot both be accommodated given the required travel time (21 minutes from Russian Hill to Golden Gate Park). To maximize the number of friends met, the optimal schedule meets four friends – choosing to meet Patricia, Laura, Ronald, and Emily.

This schedule works as follows:
• You start at the Financial District at 09:00 and travel 31 minutes to the Sunset District, arriving at 09:31 to begin a 60‐minute meeting with Patricia (within her window 09:15–22:00).
• Next, you travel 29 minutes from the Sunset District to North Beach, arriving at 11:00. Although you then wait, you meet Laura from 12:30 to 12:45 (exactly 15 minutes) in her fixed window.
• Immediately afterward, a short 4‐minute trip takes you from North Beach to Russian Hill; after a wait until 13:45, you meet Ronald for 105 minutes (13:45–15:30), which fits his window of 13:45–17:15.
• Finally, you take a 21‐minute ride from Russian Hill to The Castro, arriving around 15:51 and waiting until Emily is available; you then meet her from 16:15 to 17:15 for the full required 60 minutes (within her window 16:15–18:30).

This itinerary meets four friends – the maximum possible given the conflicting windows.
